end.summary:
Identified oxygen, nitrogen, carbon, sulphur, chlorine and iodine as non-metals.
Classified oxygen and nitrogen as gases; carbon, sulphur and iodine as solids.
Connected graphite with pencils, nitrogen with chips packets and fertilisers, and chlorine with water treatment.
Explained oxygen’s role in breathing and energy release during activity.
Teach-back did not pass; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Pari practised naming non-metals, classifying them as solids or gases, and linking them to uses such as graphite in pencils, nitrogen in chips packets and fertilisers, and chlorine in water. They used observations from packets, swimming pools and plants to explain their answers. No mix-up was recorded, so correctAfterLastSeen is not applicable; the teach-back was not completed successfully. At home, ask Pari to sort the listed non-metals into solid, liquid and gas groups and give one use for each.
